procurement_gates: No dimensions, pipe sizes, electrical ratings, pressure ratings, treatment doses or tank capacities are set in v0.1.
No component is approved for purchase until process chemistry, hydraulic duty, materials compatibility, local code and professional design reviews are complete.
Candidate treatment cassettes are comparative research configurations, not selected products.
Instrument selection requires Mycelix measurand/capability/uncertainty admission.
Pumps require the existing pump duty/efficiency owner; pressure transients require the existing transient-hydraulics owner.
